crossRefs.note: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?
Are you greater than our father, Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his…
Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his…
Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”
For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him, and he can’t know…

translations.web: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?”
translations.bsb: “How can a man be born when he is old?” Nicodemus asked. “Can he enter his mother’s womb a second time to be born?”
translations.kjv: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?
translations.asv: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter a second time into his mother's womb, and be born?
